verdict.rationale: Rainforest documents deposit (settlement) handling per merchant: deposit webhooks, configurable deposit frequency through the API, and a pre-built reporting component. This gives a programmatic signal for settlement events, but there is no documented settlement or balance report product delivered as files or APIs. missing for 10: per-seller and rolled-up settlement/balance reports, scheduled file delivery (e.g., SFTP/CSV), a reporting API built for finance-stack consumption, and independent corroboration.

support.subject: As a developer, reconciliation is automatable — settlement and balance reports per seller and rolled up, delivered as files or APIs my finance stack consumes on schedule
